title: Claim chart result
description: Export and import format of the claim chart page. The page writes every node; on import it reads only check, reading, memo, aiCheck, aiReason, aiEvidence and tr of each node, and skips a node whose text differs from the claim. Quotes in aiEvidence are verified against the target files only when the page is built, not on import. Not legal advice.

generated.description: When the page was built (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM).

exported.description: When this JSON was written (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM).

value.description: true: the sentence of the node holds for the product. false: it does not. tbd: not decided yet.

id.description: Full patent number used as the tab name, e.g. JP0000000 or US8046721.

verdict.description: OR over the claims: true when any claim is true.

aiVerdict.description: Patent verdict computed from the AI provisional checks.

target.description: What the AI compared the claims with.

nodes.description: Every node of the claim tree, parents before children.

id.description: Label such as 1B.2.1; unique inside a patent.

kind.description: and/or: gate; not: negation over one list; leaf: checked by a person; opt: optional clause, always true; ref: mirrors the cited claim.

gate.description: Gate actually used for and/or nodes, after a NOT flip and the chosen reading.

ref.description: Cited claim number, for kind ref.

text.description: The original claim text this node covers, verbatim. On import, a node whose text differs is skipped.

checkable.description: True for leaves and for nodes whose own wording is also a condition.

check.description: The person's (or an AI's) answer for this node's own wording. Read on import.

reading.description: For a node whose scope can be read two ways. Read on import.

value.description: Computed result of the node from the person's checks. Ignored on import.

worthChecking.description: False when the node is tbd but its ancestors are already decided by a sibling. Ignored on import.

memo.description: Free note, e.g. where in the product and a quote. Read on import.

aiCheck.description: AI provisional answer for this node's own wording. Read on import. Absence of a description in the target is tbd, never false.

aiReason.description: Why the AI answered so. Read on import.

aiEvidence.description: Where in the target the AI found it. Read on import.

aiValue.description: Computed result of the node from the AI layer. Ignored on import.

tr.description: Machine translation of the node's wording by language code (ja, en). [label] holes must match the node's children. Read on import.

ie.description: For a leaf under a NOT: the negation with only this leaf filled in ("i.e."), built mechanically. True/False answers this sentence.

file.description: Path of the target file (specification or code), relative to the target's root.

line.description: 1-based line where the quote starts; computed by the builder.
